record.question: The provisions of Section 31 of The State of Mizoram Act, 1986 which deals with assets and liabilities shall not apply to or in relation to:
options: Any institution, undertaking or project the expenditure in relation to which is immediately before the appointed day met from and out of the Consolidated Fund of India.
Any institution, undertaking or project financed exclusively by private donations and endowments before the appointed day.
Any institution, undertaking or project funded solely by international grants before the appointed day.
Any institution, undertaking or project whose expenditure was met from the Consolidated Fund of India from the appointed day.
